subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

One appointed to act in place of another
solution:
The correct answer is "**Deputy**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is "deputy."
 
• The word 'deputy' means someone who is appointed to act in place of another person.(सहायक)
 
• It is a noun that can be used to refer to someone who is second-in-command or a substitute.
